Name: Valley Time Capsules - Capsulas do Tempo
Author: vicbr
Description:
VALLEY TIME CAPSULES — PUBLIC BETA 0.1.0

Write a letter to your future farmer. Seal it for 7, 28 or 112 in-game days, then rediscover your message and see how your farm has changed.

FEATURES
• Letters with a title and up to 1,000 characters.
• Sealed capsules and a permanent reading archive.
• A snapshot of gold, total earnings, the five base skills and known NPC friendships.
• Before/after comparisons are fixed at the first opening.
• Optional morning notifications and a configurable hotkey (default F8).
• English and Brazilian Portuguese.

INSTALLATION
Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.0+. Built against SMAPI 4.5.2 on Windows x64. Extract the ValleyTimeCapsules folder into Mods, start through SMAPI and press F8 while free with no other menu open.

SAVE BEHAVIOR
Sleep to save capsule changes with your normal day. Exiting without saving rolls them back. Draft letters are not saved. Each save/player ID has separate data. Maximum 100 capsules.

BETA LIMITS AND TESTING
Single-player only; the menu is blocked in multiplayer. Mouse and keyboard interface. No additional modded skills are tracked. The time lock is a gameplay feature, not encryption. Compiled successfully and passed 159 automated checks for dates, validation, serialization and data isolation. The interface was previewed inside the game using sample data; a full save/sleep/reload playthrough and broad mod compatibility testing are still pending. Screenshots show sample capsules.

AI DISCLOSURE
This mod's code and page description were generated with AI assistance. It does not call an AI service during gameplay. No external artwork or assets from other mods are included.

PORTUGUÊS DO BRASIL
Escreva uma carta para seu personagem do futuro! Escolha 7, 28 ou 112 dias do jogo para abrir a cápsula e comparar seu dinheiro, ganhos, habilidades e amizades com os dados registrados ao escrevê-la.

Instalação: extraia a pasta ValleyTimeCapsules em Mods e abra o jogo pelo SMAPI. Aperte F8 para abrir o caderno. Clique nos campos para escrever; Tab alterna entre título e mensagem, Enter cria uma linha. Use os botões ou a roda do mouse para percorrer cartas longas.

Durma para salvar. Rascunhos não são salvos. Esta versão beta funciona apenas para um jogador e foi feita para mouse e teclado. O teste completo de salvar, dormir e recarregar uma partida ainda está pendente. Código e descrição desenvolvidos com IA.

UNINSTALL
Close the game and remove the ValleyTimeCapsules folder from Mods. The mod adds no world items and does not change money, inventory or friendship values.
